families.rotation: Set a new key and marker atomically on both services, deploy both, verify authenticated source attribution, then retire the prior value.

families.custody: Railway API service variables with operator escrow outside the repository
families.rotation: Add the prior KEK to the read keyring, deploy a new active KEK and KID, and rewrap every stream DEK without rewriting events. Prove exhaustive startup replay plus bounded readiness. Retire the prior KEK only if it has zero direct-envelope sentinel/reference usage; this greenfield cut requires retaining any prior KEK used by private projections or delivery credentials until a direct-envelope re-encryption and sentinel-retirement tool lands.

families.custody: Independent archive escrow outside the runtime database and repository
families.rotation: Stage and deploy the new archive KEK and KID with the prior archive KEK retained for reads, prove old archive import and new archive export, then retire the prior KEK only after the declared archive-retention window.
Issue environment-local bucket credentials, update the API references and marker, deploy and prove object reads/writes, then revoke the prior credentials.

families.custody: Dedicated environment-local Railway Bucket plus client-side wrapping and journal-authentication secrets
families.rotation: Provision and explicitly bootstrap a new dedicated authority, migrate only active wrapped keys plus every authenticated revocation, atomically update genesis/revision and both KIDs/keys, deploy and verify startup reconciliation/readiness, then revoke prior bucket credentials and retire prior client-side keys without ever restoring a deleted subject key.

families.custody: WorkOS environment plus Railway frontend service variables
families.rotation: Rotate the environment-local API key and cookie password, deploy the frontend and API marker together, verify login/callback/session exchange, then revoke the prior API key; cookie-password rotation intentionally invalidates unfinished ceremonies.
